title: Deadpool & Wolverine: How Two Failures Saved a Timeline
description: Deadpool & Wolverine (2024), MCU film; this Logan is a variant, not the resurrected Logan from the grave. A connected, source-reviewed illustrated recap with the central reversal reserved for the final act.
hook: Deadpool's world is being erased. His plan is to steal another Wolverine.
payoff: Paradox is arrested. Logan and Laura join Wade's family, and Wade reconnects with Vanessa. He couldn't undo Logan's past, but gave him a future. For more stories like this, subscribe.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Deadpool's world is being erased. His plan is to steal another Wolverine.
units.onscreen: ONE WORLD IS RUNNING OUT OF TIME
units.visual_query: ONE WORLD IS RUNNING OUT OF TIME

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: In Deadpool and Wolverine, Wade has quit hero work after the Avengers reject him and his relationship with Vanessa falls apart.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: TVA agent Paradox offers him a new life, then reveals his universe is dying because its anchor, Logan, is dead. Paradox plans to erase it faster.
units.onscreen: A NEW LIFE — AT HIS WORLD’S EXPENSE
units.visual_query: A NEW LIFE — AT HIS WORLD’S EXPENSE

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Wade digs up Logan, fights agents with the adamantium bones, then searches other realities. He returns with a Wolverine haunted by failing his X-Men.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Paradox says a replacement won't work and dumps them in the Void. Cassandra Nova, Xavier's twin, kills their companion Johnny Storm. They escape Alioth.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Wade admits he can't promise to repair Logan's past. Their partnership becomes a brutal car fight, until Laura and the resistance find them.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Blade, Elektra, Gambit and Laura help storm Cassandra's base. Juggernaut's helmet blocks her powers, but Paradox's agent Pyro shoots her.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Logan insists they save her. Cassandra opens a portal home, then learns about the Time Ripper and follows them, planning to destroy every timeline.
units.onscreen: SAVING HER CREATES A BIGGER THREAT
units.visual_query: SAVING HER CREATES A BIGGER THREAT

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Her Deadpool army kills Nicepool and blocks the street. Wade and Logan fight through, until Peter arrives and charms the variants.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: To stop the machine, someone must bridge matter and antimatter. Paradox says they'll die. Wade locks Logan out and takes both power lines.

units.speaker: Narrator
units.text: Logan breaks in and grabs Wade. Together they overload the machine, destroy Cassandra and survive by sharing the burden. Their timeline stabilizes.

units.speaker: Host
units.text: Paradox is arrested. Logan and Laura join Wade's family, and Wade reconnects with Vanessa. He couldn't undo Logan's past, but gave him a future. For more stories like this, subscribe.
units.onscreen: A FUTURE, EVEN WITH THE SAME PAST
